chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Riches and destitution will follow presentation before Allah.
ai.seo_question: What determines true wealth and poverty according to Imam Ali in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this saying from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) clarifies that while material wealth and poverty are often viewed as worldly states, their true essence is determined only after the soul's presentation before Allah. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding that divine judgment transcends superficial economic conditions, redefining 'riches' and 'destitution' as spiritual realities contingent upon one's final standing in the Hereafter. The phrase 'after presentation' (ba'da al-'ard) emphasizes the eschatological moment when all hidden intentions and outward actions are fully revealed.
